q: The dimension group of an SFT with adjacency matrix A is the inductive limit group:
opts: (ℤ^n, A): the group ℤ^n with the automorphism induced by A, forming the direct limit under multiplication by A
exp: The dimension group (Krieger, 1980) is the direct limit G(A) = lim_{→} (ℤ^n →^A ℤ^n), with the automorphism induced by A. It is a complete invariant for eventual conjugacy (flow equivalence) of SFTs and connects symbolic dynamics to K-theory.
